title: The periodic table closes at Z = 172 as 43 FCC cells

statements.text: An integer index $\mathrm{Ind}(PuP) = 86$ fixes the 86 states of each of two mirrored halves of the periodic system, and the 172 states assemble into exactly 43 face-centered cubic unit cells of 4 nodes. The table therefore ends at $Z = 172$ as a crystallographic closure, not an arbitrary limit.

sources.quote: The end of the periodic table at $Z=172$ is therefore not an arbitrary limit, but the strict crystallographic closure requirement of the macroscopic vacuum lattice.
is not a numerological coincidence but the strict shadow of a single integer topological invariant
